additional_info.subject: RE: ID0393536-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / S2 170003300] Charging session interrupted CRM:00921001360
additional_info.body:
Dear Lorenz Wojtowski,
Hope you are doing well.
We have analyzed the logs for the given timestamp and found that the charging session for a single EV was interrupted, with error code 38 reported. This error indicates that the state machine failed to process the message and aborted the V2G communication.
Regards,
Beerpal Singh
eMobility Support
Please do not change the subject line with replying back to this email.
